newsitem.title: CHINA: Thai tour group aboard ill-fated China airliner.
newsitem.headline: Thai tour group aboard ill-fated China airliner.

text.p: A group of Thai tourists were aboard a China Southern Airlines Boeing 737 that crash-landed during a thunderstorm in China's southern city of Shenzhen, an airline spokesman said on Friday.
It was not immediately known how many people were in the group or if any of them were among the 30 reported killed.
Staff at one Shenzhen hospital said two middle-aged Thai men had been injured but that their condition was not serious.
The Hong Kong Standard quoted a spokesman for Shenzhen's People's Hospital as saying one Thai woman was admitted with multiple fractures of her knees, ribs and head, but her condition was stable.
A Boeing spokesman in Beijing said it appeared around 30 people were killed when the three-year-old 737-300 crashed and burned at around 9.30 p.m. (1330 GMT) on Thursday night.
Flight CZ3456 was carrying 65 passengers and nine crew and on a scheduled route from the southwestern city of Chongqing to Shenzhen, on the Chinese border with Hong Kong, when the accident happened.
